This layer is about handing that decision away from the human: the human proposes, then another agent proposes, then darwin can assign itself work, and finally darwin researches and prioritises on its own, with randomness to stop it staring at one spot.

It confirmed a premise: darwin editing its own source does not break itself. But there was one source of direction — me.

现在开始你扮演一个开发者，不要修改 repo 中的任何代码，只负责提出需求，用: From now on you play a developer. Do not modify any code in the repo; only propose requirements and use darwin to iterate on itself… For the next requirement, launch the newest darwin.
Claude Code 以开发者口吻提出的前六个需求。第 6 条 /compac: The first six requirements Claude Code proposed as a developer. No. 6, /compact, was done on the model connected in No. 5. The source of direction moved from the human to another agent — still outside darwin.

低于 6 分的不进；报告里记一笔“考虑过，拒绝”。进了 backlog 的方向逐: Below 6 stays out, recorded as "considered, rejected". Backlog directions go to developer one at a time.
全部维度打平均分正好是 6：一个平平无奇的方向不值得一次迭代。分数不能事后改，改: Average marks everywhere give exactly 6: an unremarkable direction is not worth an iteration. Scores cannot be changed after the fact without a record.
让模型自己选方向，会陷进局部最优: Left alone, the model picks a local optimum
借随机梯度下降的思路：给选择加一点随机扰动，摇骰子决定这次往哪看: Borrow from SGD: add random perturbation — roll a die for where to look
模型自己选研究什么，每次都去看同类产品，提出来的总是别人已有的功能；让它自查，它: Choosing for itself, the model always went to peer products and proposed features they already had; asked to inspect itself, it picked what it knew best. A local optimum: each step goes where things look best now, and soon nothing else is visible.
随机数必须由脚本产生，模型自己“随便选一个”时给出的并不随机。: The random number must come from a script; when a model "just picks one", the pick is not random.
摇出来的结果算数，skill 里定了几条规矩: The roll is binding; the skill sets the rules
一次研究只摇一次，读任何资料之前摇。: Roll once per run, before reading anything.
输出原样抄进报告，不能改写。: Copy the output into the report verbatim.
不喜欢也不能重摇；没发现就如实写“没有发现”，不悄悄换路。: No re-rolling; if nothing is found, say "nothing found" — never switch paths quietly.
人用 --path 指定时，报告里必须留着 path-source: overr: A human --path override must keep path-source: override in the report.
骰子只决定证据从哪来，不改变评分、门槛和交付方式。: The die only picks the evidence source; scoring, gate and hand-off stay the same.
先读了再摇，就等于挑。: Reading first, then rolling, is choosing.
加了骰子之后，backlog 里开始出现看别家产品看不出来的方向。每条路径的方向: With the die, directions appeared in the backlog that no comparable product would have suggested. Each is checked against the research path recorded under docs/research/.

方向定了之后，每一轮怎么做好？: Once set, how does each round go well?
有了方向，还要让每一轮的执行越来越顺：弯路少一点、token 省一点、验收不被糊: Directions are not enough; each round has to get smoother — fewer detours, fewer tokens, acceptance that can't be fooled. This layer covers how darwin finds improvements in its own run records, what went wrong over three weeks and what changed, and what kept the loop from running out of control.
让 darwin 读自己的运行轨迹，打分、找原因，把改进点写回 backlog: darwin reads its own trajectory, grades it, finds causes, writes improvements to the backlog
每个会话都有一份只追加的 trajectory.jsonl：用户输入、每次工具调: Every session has an append-only trajectory.jsonl: user input, every tool call, model responses, tokens, why each turn ended. Meant for replay and export, it is also the material for reflection. /self-reflection starts a fresh headless darwin to read it and write against a template:
完美 / 高 / 中 / 低，各有明确定义。十次里有四次打了“低”。: Perfect / high / medium / low, each defined. Four of ten runs graded "low".
哪些弯路能靠改提示词、工具描述、上下文管理、agent 编排避免。: Which detours could be avoided by changing prompts, tool descriptions, context management, orchestration.
值得做的写进 backlog，交给 developer；重复的标记重复，不再入队: Worthwhile ones go to the backlog and developer; duplicates are marked, not queued again.
第一次反思找出两条：流中断后一个 11 分钟的回合卡死等人输 continue；: The first reflection found two: an 11-minute turn frozen after a stream interruption, waiting for a human "continue"; a wasted call from an extra field in bash status. SRF-003 was rejected for weak evidence, reason stated — not pushed through by bending the score.
Host 自己看 diff、跑测试: Host reads the diff, runs tests
新版本接手下一轮: New build takes the next round

人保留的：给方向、产品取舍、安全边界、授权 push。其余的，darwin 自己: The human keeps: direction, product trade-offs, safety boundaries, push authorisation. The rest, darwin runs itself.
最先碰到的问题：token 烧得太快: The first problem: tokens burned too fast
8 月 17 日统计的一个批次。同一个子会话从 planning 续到第四轮修正: One batch tallied on August 17. A single child session ran from planning through a fourth correction; cached context read per call grew from 230K to 790K, and the last round produced 3,111 output tokens while reading 17.4M from cache. Planning alone took 37% of output.
不再拆 planning child 和 implementation chil: No more planning child plus implementation child, each reviewed once; one complete worker goes through research, implementation, checks and commit, and the Host accepts independently only at the end.
互不依赖的读取、搜索、检查在同一条消息里批量发出。现在一个方向典型花费 1–16: Independent reads, searches and checks go out in one message. A direction now typically costs $1–16 and 12–170 calls.
后期的修正本身不贵，贵的是它们一直带着前面所有的历史。: The late corrections are cheap; carrying all the preceding history is what costs.
监督子进程比子进程干活还贵: Supervision cost more than the work
一个批次 390 次工具调用，322 次是 Host 在轮询两个子进程的 sta: In one batch 322 of 390 tool calls were the Host polling two children, each wake a full-context model call. First a blocking wait of up to 30 minutes; then the reverse: start returns at once, the Host may end its turn, and a <task-notification> enters the prompt queue when the job finishes.
反思要敢打低分: Reflection must dare to grade low
十次里四次“低”：结论形成了没发出去、轨迹定位不匹配、最后一个回合没闭合。未闭合: Four "low" out of ten: a conclusion formed but never sent, a trajectory locator mismatch, an unclosed last turn. The last became SRF-012: reflect only on closed turns.
同一个错，不换假设就别再试: No retry without a new hypothesis
一次服务端校验失败，darwin 换着参数连试了六种变体，12 分钟、1.1 万: After one server-side validation failure darwin tried six parameter variants — 12 minutes, 11K output tokens — until a human cancelled. Reflection proposed the SRF-016 retry guard: same failure signature, the second retry needs an evidence-backed hypothesis, the third stops and reports, the fourth is refused.
Trellis 前三周有用；切到 Claude Fable 5.1 后，模型自己: Trellis helped for three weeks; after switching to Claude Fable 5.1 the model read AGENTS.md and ran the spikes on its own, and Trellis became a second rulebook. Removed wholesale on September 4, keeping only its one principle.
每个会话从零开始，上一代只能靠文件传给下一代。AGENTS.md 预载进系统提示: Each session starts from zero; a generation reaches the next only through files. AGENTS.md is preloaded into the system prompt with a table of invariants, code locations and verifying scripts (32 KB cap). Every batch appends to the iteration log. "Specs injected, not remembered."
spike/ 下一百三十来个脚本：真实 pty 驱动 TUI、真的 git 仓库: About 130 scripts under spike/: a real pty driving the TUI, real git repos, direct model calls. pnpm test runs the 100 model-free suites. When the child says "tests pass", the Host gets the same answer from the same command.
提前说好哪些事归人管: Say up front what is the human's
产品取舍、安全边界、授权是人的。工作树不干净、起点无法验证、验收反复失败、前提被: Product trade-offs, safety boundaries, authorisation are human. Dirty tree, unverifiable start, repeated acceptance failure, falsified premise — the batch stops and records why. darwin knows where to stop when nobody is there.
每一轮都用刚改出来的 darwin 做下一轮: The new build runs the next round
验收通过、提交后立刻 build，下一个方向就由新 darwin 来做。改动一提: Accept, commit, build — the next direction is done by the new darwin. A change enters real work the moment it lands: a good one smooths the next round, a bad one gets run into by it. Each improvement's result feeds the quality of the next.

结论：能力差不多，darwin 更省。: Conclusion: about equal in capability, darwin cheaper.
high 和 medium 两个档下，darwin 与 Claude Code: At both high and medium, darwin and Claude Code score the same (12 vs 12, 13 vs 13) and darwin costs 7% and 11% less, the difference being input tokens. At high, 18 tasks agree; the two disagreements go opposite ways.

对照坐标来自 Lilian Weng《Harness Engineering f: Coordinates from Lilian Weng, "Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement" (July 2026). Three harness design patterns: workflow automation, file system as persistent memory, sub-agents and background jobs. The optimisation ladder: prompts → structured context → workflow → harness code → optimizer code. Self-improvement loops: Self-Harness's propose–evaluate–accept, AHE's seven editable components and three layers of observability. Next slide places darwin on these coordinates.

RSI 是智能改进智能；darwin 改的是模型外面那层 harness。Dee: RSI is intelligence improving intelligence; darwin edits the harness around the model. DeepSWE: swapping the harness stays within noise — the ceiling is the model's.
AHE 把 verifier 和模型配置设成只读；darwin 的测试和权限门在: AHE makes verifier and model config read-only; darwin's tests and permission gate live in the same repo, held by Host re-runs and human diff review — contained, not solved structurally.
DGM 有档案库和多父代；darwin 每个验收通过的 commit 是唯一父代: DGM has an archive and multiple parents; darwin's accepted commit is the sole parent. Diversity comes from the die; negative results survive as low grades and rejected directions.
下一步：给好坏一个数字: Next: put a number on good and bad
backlog 的 Score 五个维度都是 1–5 的主观评级。: The five backlog score dimensions are subjective 1–5 ratings.
验收标准是“没有回归”，不是“darwin 变强了”。: Acceptance means "no regression", not "darwin got stronger".
反思只看自己的一次会话：评价者和被评价者是同一个系统。: Reflection sees one of its own sessions: evaluator and evaluatee are the same system.
名字叫 darwin，却没有一个外部的、可复现的、量化的 fitness fun: Named darwin, yet without an external, reproducible, quantitative fitness function.
每个候选 commit 在固定模型、任务子集、参数下跑 Harbor，和 bas: Each candidate commit runs Harbor under a fixed model, task subset and parameters; compare pass@1, cost and duration with the baseline.
快速层：5–8 题 smoke，触及 agent 核心的 commit 验收时跑: Fast tier: a 5–8 task smoke set, run at acceptance for commits touching the agent core.
慢速层：Terminal-Bench 2.0 全部 89 题 + DeepSWE: Slow tier: all 89 Terminal-Bench 2.0 + all 113 DeepSWE tasks, refreshing the baseline each release.
研究 skill 加一条 bench 路径：从 reward = 0 的 tri: A bench path in the research skill mines reward = 0 trials for darwin-side defects.
留外集：一个 hold-out 子集永远不进 smoke。: Held-out set: a hold-out subset never enters smoke.
验证器在回路外：verifier 跑在独立容器里；任务内容和解法不进 skill: Verifier outside the loop: a separate container; task content and solutions never enter skills, memory or AGENTS.md.
标量信号：对 baseline 的差值，Evidence confidence: Scalar signal: the delta against baseline — Evidence confidence gets a number.
底线：只有同一模型、同一参数、不同 darwin commit 的差值才算 da: Bottom line: only the delta between same model, same parameters, different darwin commits is darwin's signal.
已到阶段 0：external/harbor submodule，darwin: At stage 0: external/harbor submodule, darwin adapter in the fork, plan in docs/architecture/harbor-benchmark-rsi.md. Risks: a full DeepSWE run may cost $100+ and hours; single-task pass fluctuates between runs, so small subsets show only trends and severe regressions; Goodhart is countered by the hold-out and "task content never enters memory".
在明确的边界内自己找方向: Find directions within a clear boundary
自己实现、自己验收、自己记录: Implement, accept and record on its own
把学到的东西传给下一代: Pass what it learned to the next generation
用新版本立刻验证上一版的改动: Verify the last version's changes with the new build at once
这个实验至少说明：在三万多行的仓库、三个星期的尺度上，这些判断之外的活是可以交出: What the experiment shows, at least: in a 30k-line repo over three weeks, the work outside those judgements can be handed over. After three-plus weeks, roughly 10–20% of directions still needed my explicit guidance; left to explore, it might have got where I wanted, but at a much greater cost in time and money.
